versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
For metallic materials, see AMC.603 (a); for composite materials, see AMC.603 (b)
(a) The suitability and durability of materials used for parts, the failure of which could adversely affect safety, must
  (1) Be established by experience or tests;
  (2) Meet approved specifications that ensure their having the strength and other properties assumed in the design data; and
  (3) Take into account the effects of environmental conditions, such as temperature, humidity, UV, chemical, solvent, fuel, electromagnetic radiation, and airborne particulates expected in service.
(b) Workmanship must be of a high standard.
(c) All hazardous materials shall be identified and their safe use will be accounted for.

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UA Design and Construction
versions.text:
For metallic materials, see AMC.603 (a); for composite materials, see AMC.603 (b) and AMC 20-29
(a) The suitability and durability of materials used for parts, the failure of which could adversely affect safety, must:
  (1) Be established by experience or tests;
  (2) Meet approved specifications that ensure they have the strength and other properties to meet the design requirements; and
  (3) Take into account the effects of environmental conditions, such as temperature, humidity, UV, chemical, solvent, fuel, electromagnetic radiation, and airborne particulates expected in service.
(b) Workmanship must be of a high standard.
(c) The UA materials shall obtain environmental qualification, as applicable, at the component and system level for both natural and induced environments.
(d) All hazardous materials shall be identified and their safe use will be accounted for.
